After an unusual three-week wait, Apple today released iOS 27 beta 5, rolling out a fresh set of icons for several apps including Siri and Safari.

Apple redesigns app icons in iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to public release, expected to launch next month.

Today's beta 5 includes a number of user-facing changes, paving the way for its official rollout.

Among them, several built-in apps have been given new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above, while other apps have also received minor updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has been gradually introducing icon design changes, with Apple continuing to refine last year's Liquid Glass aesthetic.

Apps such as Maps, Photos, and Wallet have adopted new icons since iOS 27 testing began. However, the revisions in today's beta 5 show that Apple has not yet finished tweaking the iOS 27 icons.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
